title: Making grammars: From computing with shapes to computing with things
edition_version: 2015 journal article, pp.8–28. Reading copy: MIT author-final manuscript, separately paginated pp.1–21 plus repository cover sheet.
relevance: A developed account of making grammars, sensory attention and material-specific algebras, with drawing and knotting examples and a speculative watercolor extension.
prerequisites: Elementary sets and functions; some proof reading

license_redistribution.conditions: The MIT record and manuscript cover identify CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for the author-final manuscript. Retain the institutional reading link; no new original is mirrored. Do not extend that license to the publisher version or separately credited images.

Manuscript pp.10–11: §4.1 and Fig.3, seeing and drawing
Manuscript pp.11–16: §4.2, Figs.8–9 and string algebra
Manuscript pp.17–20: §4.3 and §5, watercolor proposal and discussion

verification.scope: Reviewed 2026-10-20. Read the complete MIT author-final manuscript: repository cover sheet and manuscript pp.1–21. Visually checked the knotting rules in Fig.8 and the string-algebra definition on manuscript pp.14–15. This is the author-final manuscript, not the typeset journal version (published pp.8–28). Examples illustrate a theory; no controlled performance study is reported. The watercolor example is explicitly speculative, with no completed painting grammar.
